name: obsidian
description: Obsidian commit-context capture and verified public runtime setup for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Capture commit context and set up the public runtime
interface.longDescription: Preserve Codex commit context in Obsidian and preview or apply verified public runtime installation. Runtime setup does not register servers, activate native profiles, transfer capture ownership, or install hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $commit-capture to save the latest successful commit and its conversation context to Obsidian.
